events.body:
## Context

`public/app.js` (about L313-327) sorts on `click` on `<th data-column>` only, with no tabindex, key handler or `aria-sort`.

## What to do

1. Put a `<button>` inside each `<th>` (or add tabindex + Enter/Space).
2. Set `aria-sort` on the active column. Don't add inline `onclick` (a test forbids it).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tab + Enter sorts
- [ ] `aria-sort` reflects the sort
- [ ] `test/app-escaping.test.mjs` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-metadata
```
